lead: One large tile leads, and the others fill the grid around it. Use it when one feature matters most; use the feature grid when all are equal.

tiles.title: The lead tile takes two cells
tiles.text: It also gets a larger title, so the layout shows what matters by size alone. Only the first tile gets this, and only when there is room for three columns.

tiles.title: Three columns on wide screens
tiles.text: Two on medium screens and one on a phone. Nothing else moves.

tiles.title: The other tiles are standard
tiles.text: The same card, icon and optional link as in the other feature elements.

tiles.title: Any tile can be a link
tiles.text: The whole tile becomes clickable, and the title names the link for screen readers.
